title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary: Fixed forms playground drag-and-drop to match flow/puzzle2d patterns. Catalogue palette now uses full pointer+HTML5 drag session with floating ghost preview, global drop bridge, and accent ring on builder preview. Drops commit to hierarchy tree rows (before/after/inside) or builder preview default target. Hierarchy reorder uses correct target item ids. ui-react Tree handleDragOver now allows copy drops for application/* palette MIME types so catalogue→hierarchy HTML5 drag works.
